title: Play In to Out plays only the marked stretch
goal: With an In and an Out set on the timeline, a person can play just the marked stretch and stop at the Out, the way Premiere's Play In to Out does, so they can check a stretch before exporting or extracting it. Plain play keeps running to the end as it does today.
notes: Split out of export-and-playback-keep-to-the-in-and-out-marks, whose title named playback but whose acceptance covered export only; export shipped there. Premiere binds Play In to Out to Cmd+Shift+Space on Mac (check before binding: TimelineMenuKeys). Marks: PhotonzDocument.markedRangeMS / exportRangeMS(.marked) in Sources/PhotonzCore/VideoExportRange.swift. Ruler menu rows: EditorState+TimelineMenus.swift timelineRulerMenuRows.
acceptance: With In and Out set, Play In to Out (Premiere's key, and a row on the ruler right-click menu) starts at the In and stops at the Out
With no marks set the command is absent or plays the whole video
A walk at Next defaults sets marks, plays In to Out and checks the playhead stops at the Out
